name: placement-v1-reference
description: Complete, reproducible Placement Test V1 reference configuration. Recreated by `npm --prefix server run import:placement-reference` through the canonical Placement V1 HTTP surfaces (real routers, validators, RBAC, persistence and audit). The fixture contains configuration and assessment content only: no candidates, attempts, payments, audit history, credentials, or PII.
